class.name: OcgBreptoolsModifier
class.brief_description: Performs geometric modifications on a shape.
class.description: ! Performs geometric modifications on a shape.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a modifier on the shape <S>.

method.name: from_3
method.description: Creates a modifier on the shape <S>, and performs the modifications described by <M>.

method.name: Init
method.description: Initializes the modifier with the shape <S>.

method.name: IsDone
method.description: Returns Standard_True if the modification has been computed successfully.

method.name: IsMutableInput
method.description: Returns the current mutable input state

method.name: SetMutableInput
method.description: Sets the mutable input state If true then the input (original) shape can be modified during modification process

method.name: ModifiedShape
method.description: Returns the modified shape corresponding to <S>.
